summary: Mergeable with minor issues related to maintainability and documentation.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor maintainability issue by adding a new dtype check without updating the docstring to reflect this change.
The patch does not include additional tests to cover the new dtype check.
The patch uses a minor style inconsistency by adding a new line without a blank line before it.
The patch does not update the docstring to reflect the new dtype check.
